scan_assets.use: rounded granite masses (lower cliff, beside the plunge)
small lichen rock-face pieces (beside the groove, upper rim)
bank / shallows boulders (instanced), a few cliff-foot pieces
tiled texture: cliff backing face, walk slabs, seats, cobbles

texture_estimate.note: Rock set (scan albedo + normal per asset, tiled backing, slab, macro) ~1041 KB as WebP q80 (the GLB as exported 3634 KB vs round 3's 3443 KB; ground / foliage / tree maps unchanged from round 3 are ~1.9 MB of it). For the 1.6 MB waterfall.glb target W3 must shrink both: rock at 512 (scan albedo + normal, backing) is ~437 KB; ground normals turf_n / gravel_n at 512 or KTX2 save ~0.6 MB; geometry (Draco) is ~766 KB.

contract_changes.falls_rock_lod0/lod1: one mesh per tier, 5 material slots: 0 M_falls_rock (backing face, tiled scan texture T_falls_rock_base_d/_n 512), 1..4 M_falls_scan_<cliff2|cliff1|face2|boulder3> (UV0 = each scan's own baked albedo + GL normal map, 1024 for cliff2/cliff1, 512 for face2/boulder3). All slots: UV2 = the face's (z, y) square, T_falls_rock_macro RGB x2 (0.5 = x1) - now RGB only, no relief alpha, T_falls_rock_macro_n dropped. 'Col' R moss (up-facing, damp), G wet (darker + glossier); B and A are 0 (streaks / lichen live in the macro). Materials are double-sided (glTF doubleSided): the scan shells are closed, but the contract clamps cut a few open.
contract_changes.W3 lightmap: UV2 is a planar (z, y) projection and the stacked scan pieces OVERLAP in it (side / under faces share texels with the faces in front). It stays right for the macro colour map, but W3 must bake the cliff's lightmap into its own non-overlapping UV (e.g. a UV3 lightmap pack of falls_rock_lod*), or bake AO into vertex colours.
contract_changes.rock kit: inst__falls_rock_k is now k = 0..3 (was 0..6): scan boulders (0 boulder3 lo, 1 boulder1 lo, 2 boulder3 hi, 3 boulder1 hi) with M_falls_boulder_boulder3 / _boulder1 (same textures as the scan materials, no macro). Mesh origin = bbox centre.
contract_changes.slabs/seats/cobbles: M_falls_slab now T_falls_slab_d (512, low-contrast grade of the lichen_rock scan) + T_falls_rock_base_n. Tops unchanged.
contract_changes.dropped textures: T_falls_rock, T_falls_rock_n, T_falls_rock_macro_n, T_falls_slab, T_falls_slab_n (round-3 procedural)
contract_changes.W2 water: groove core (|z - channel z| < 2.4 m above the ledge): the backing face is face_x minimised over each grid cell, so the drawn rock is never in front of face_x (raycast: <= 0.010 m lod0 / 0.023 m lod1 out) and at most 1.46 / 2.06 m behind it in W0's narrow cracks and sheet steps (cut inward only). Band 2.4-3.8 m and the plunge zone (|z - lip z| < 7.5 m below the ledge): no vertex out of face_x (pieces stop 3 cm behind it; triangles that would bridge the concave groove / alcove are dropped). W2's sheets can keep sitting on face_x.
contract_changes.W4 runtime / W5 walk: no change: layout numbers, pocket ground 0, slabs 0.02-0.04, seats 0.42, camera wall gap >= 0.5 m all hold.
contract_changes.W6 village: no change: site box, seam heights, flank / ground meshes as round 3 (flank grid coarser, same surface).
contract_changes.tiers: falls_rock_lod1 = the lo LOD of every scan piece + a coarser backing face (low tier); trees 30 (every 4th on low).
